'''Boonta Races''' were a series of racing events held on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Arami]]<ref name="Podracing">{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}}</ref> as part of the festivities during the [[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta's Eve]] holiday.<ref name="Holidays">{{SW|url=news/the-best-holidays-and-celebrations-in-the-galaxy-everybodys-invited-of-course|text=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|int=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|nolive=1}}</ref>
